profile.headline: Full Stack Developer Helping Build Solutions For The Future
profile.summary: Developer with over 6 years of professional experience working in an enterprise agile development environment. Skilled in Java, Spring Boot, CSS / SCSS, Javascript, React, Graphics / UI design and Node.js.  Continually learning new skills and technologies. I would love to get involved in that next great idea.
